summary: New dellemc.openmanage modules in 10.4.0: idrac_secure_boot for importing secure boot certificates, and idrac_support_assist for running and exporting SupportAssist logs.
questions: Which module collects SupportAssist logs from iDRAC?

answer_card.title: New iDRAC modules in 10.4.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_secure_boot`: import secure boot certificates.
- `idrac_support_assist`: run and export SupportAssist collection logs on iDRAC.
